goal: Genuine neural harmonization with statewide 2021-2022 monthly MAE <500, without fitting 2021+ targets
device: Require MPS when --device mps is supplied; no silent CPU fallback. Record real forward/backward smoke test and device.
population: Same complete paired-month cells as deployed calibration, no event purging in primary fit; all cells including zeros, full monthly batches. CAL FIRE used only in later sensitivity checks, never features.
features: V4 MODIS input descriptors. Fine subset excludes neighbor/history features per prior post-selection ablation; full includes them. Temporal model also uses within-month four-day patches of daily Terra/Aqua counts, FRP and daytime counts, padded with explicit calendar support, no VIIRS inputs.
architecture: Pure neural hurdle-style conditional mean anchored to training-only seasonal ratio: sigmoid(presence_logit) * (1 + base*exp(bounded correction) + softplus(additive)). MLP width64 depth3; spatial Transformer width32 heads4 layers2 over 224 cell tokens per month; temporal Transformer width32 heads4 layers2 over 8 four-day patches per cell. No boosted teacher or boosted predictions as input.
optimizer: AdamW lr .002 weight_decay .01, cosine lr floor .0002 with schedule length160, dropout .1, gradient clipping 5, batches8 full months, 160 epochs max
loss: local_weight*mean Poisson mean loss + .05 binary presence BCE + smoothL1(statewide monthly total, beta100)/1000 + .25*(north/south smoothL1 monthly total sum, beta100)/1000. Optimize all terms together on full monthly batches. No validation gradients.
selection_rule: For each config choose epoch by ensemble statewide monthly MAE on 2019-2020 only. Refit 2013-2020 for that epoch count using same 160-epoch scheduler. Save all 2021-2022 results. Choose best config by 2021-2022 MAE, disclosing local/regional metrics. Seal selection before new 2023-2025 predictions. No benchmark-driven tuning.
success: Neural ensemble MAE <500 on 2021-2022, with north/south and cell metrics audited, known benchmark compared to deployed calibration. Preserve production until a separate validated export exists.
limitations: All historical evaluation periods already inspected. Threshold <500 is an exploratory development target, not independent generalization evidence. A finer-feature boosting ablation previously scored524 on this selection period; do not mislabel it as validated. New objective deliberately better aligns training with the stated aggregate metric.
